summary: Vylor Inc., a wholly owned Corteva subsidiary, filed an 8-K reporting an extension of its private exchange offers and consent solicitations for EIDP notes, pushing expiration to September 30, 2026 from September 29. As of the prior deadline, $434.841 million, or 86.97%, of EIDP's 2.300% Senior Notes due 2030 had been validly tendered. Vylor is offering new Vylor notes for EIDP notes and seeking consents to amend related indentures. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch participation and consent thresholds, since failure to achieve required consents could affect completion mechanics and noteholder treatment.
